checks.name: initial reset
checks.observation: R restored 100/100 hull, score 000000, eight objects, and the centered ship.

checks.name: movement and rotation
checks.observation: Repeated real W and D key presses moved the ship above the landing ring and visibly changed its heading.

checks.name: short fire tap
checks.observation: A quick Space press was initially lost between fixed ticks. Fire now consumes held or edge input; one visible bullet raised the object count from eight to nine.

checks.name: normal fire rate limit
checks.observation: Eight immediate Space presses produced one live bullet, not eight; the object count was nine.

checks.name: collision, homing, score, and expiry
checks.observation: A guided shot curved toward the asteroid field and raised score to 15 on hit. Later rapid-fire shots destroyed multiple asteroids and raised score to 340; transient bullets and explosions swept from the object count.

checks.name: shield pickup
checks.observation: Steering into the cyan plus removed that pickup, reduced object count to seven, and added 25 score.

checks.name: rapid-fire pickup
checks.observation: Steering into the lightning module changed the HUD to RAPID 5.4s. Five Space presses at 100 ms intervals produced five visible projectiles and an object count of 12.

checks.name: damage, destruction, and respawn
checks.observation: Asteroid contact reduced the hull, destruction showed SIGNAL LOST with a live countdown, and the ship returned after the two-second transition.

checks.name: wrap
checks.observation: Sustained thrust carried the ship through the lower/right boundary and it reappeared at the upper/left side without a cross-arena interpolation streak.

checks.name: telemetry and reset
checks.observation: H toggled the 120-interval panel; SIM CLOCK, TOTAL TICKS, CLAMP LOST, and alpha continued updating. R reset gameplay while loop telemetry continued.

checks.name: resize and DPR
checks.observation: Desktop CSS size 1025.64x649.57 mapped to a 1200x760 backing store at DPR 1.17. Narrow CSS size 333.33x598.29 mapped to a 390x700 backing store; controls and HUD remained legible.

checks.name: focus, blur, and hidden cleanup
checks.observation: Canvas focus was visible and document.hidden remained false when the in-app browser UI was hidden or another in-app tab opened, so that host cannot exercise a real visibility transition. The existing EventTarget regression test verifies blur and hidden-page cleanup.

checks.name: background and resume
checks.observation: The in-app host kept document.hidden=false while backgrounded. The preserved Lab 01 browser evidence and fixed-loop tests cover resume clamping; this run does not claim a new hidden-tab measurement.

checks.name: console
checks.observation: No warning or error entries after reset, telemetry, resize, movement, firing, pickup, collision, destruction, respawn, and wrap checks.
